_README: Declares the jmix:mainResource content architecture for salonphoto. mainResource units are NOT pages: they are content nodes created inside a jnt:contentFolder and listed by a sdp:jcrQuery whose startNode points at that folder. Consumed by orchestration/lib/load_main_resources.py, gated by orchestration/probes/startnode.sh + mainresource.sh. Human-editable; every folder below was derived from MEASURED evidence (card-reached detail URLs found in the scoped mirror + the census's uncrawled-prefix ledger), never from assumption. THE RULE: nav-reachable = page; card-reached dated prose = entity; ties break to page.

_evidence.rule: None of the URL prefixes below appears in the source MENU (orchestration/sitemaps/salonphoto.txt) — each is reached only from listing cards, and each card carries a date + a category badge + a title. That is the entity signature.
_evidence.note: Entity DETAIL pages are deliberately absent from the menu-scoped capture. They must be crawled (--url-list of the detail URLs) before load_main_resources can run; that same crawl also completes the declared-component inventory, since the 2026-06 run saw 42 declared types against this run's 36 — the 6 extras (image-content-block-description, key-figures, anchors-links, item-content-popin-picture, event-list, video) live on detail pages.

sitemapEnumeration._why: The menu gives the IA; the SITEMAP gives entity completeness. 144 fr-FR URLs, 122 of them outside our 27-page menu capture.
sitemapEnumeration._note: The sitemap does NOT list the programme /Evenement/ events (37) nor the catalogue /Exposant//Marque//Produit/ details (33) — those are search-indexed items, found only by the link census. Sitemap UNION link census is the complete entity set: ~187 details.

actualites._evidence: 57 article URLs enumerated from /sitemap.xml — the listing renders only 6 and hides the rest behind a load-more that calls the absent SXA search API, so the captured DOM showed 9 links. MEASURED field surface from two fetched details: title component carries field-titre + field-date-de-publication; the standfirst is the intro band's field-content (it matches the meta description); body prose is field-description across content/rich-text bands.

agenda._evidence: 19 detail cards on actualite-photo_agenda-photo: 'Agenda | Expositions | DD/MM/YYYY | <exhibition title>' -> /fr-FR/actualite-photo/agenda-photo/<slug>. Dated, venue-bearing prose = event, not article.

programme._evidence: The LARGEST entity cluster: 37 uncrawled links under a literal /Evenement/ path segment (the source's own word for it). The programme-salon listing renders them inside tabs/accordion, so a link-selector sweep of the listing found 0 — the census's prefix ledger is what surfaced them. Same Jahia type as agenda, different folder + listing.
programme._secondShape: The programme family has TWO URL shapes: /programme-salon/Evenement/<slug> (37, the listing's own links) and /programme-salon/<slug> (linked from article prose). Both are the same entity. The prefix matches with a trailing slash, so the listing PAGE itself (/programme-salon, no trailing segment) is untouched.

expositions._evidence: 9 uncrawled detail links. OPEN QUESTION for the review gate: these may be sub-pages rather than entities — the listing page has only 5 bands. If the details turn out to be nav-reachable, the rule breaks the tie to PAGE and this folder is dropped.

animations._evidence: 6 uncrawled detail links, same open question as expositions.

rencontres._evidence: MISSED in the first pass, found by the link census: 3 card-reached details (forum-pros, grandes-rencontres, tete-a-tete-filles-de-la-photo). Two of them are linked from the HOME page's picture-grid, which is what exposed the gap.

communiques._evidence: 7 press releases enumerated from /sitemap.xml. This family was invisible to BOTH the menu capture (the press area is not in the main menu) and the first link census (its only in-page links are in the FOOTER, which the census was not scanning). Same type as actualites, own folder + listing.

_scopeQuestions.question: The exhibitor catalogue (/fr-FR/infos-pratiques/catalogue, + an uncrawled /fr-FR/exposants) is a searchable exhibitor directory. Its list is NOT in the captured DOM — the page's 43 internal links are all mega-menu chrome, and the catalogue itself carries SXA facet components (facet-dropdown x4, facet-aggregated, facet-summary, load-more) whose /sxa/search backend does not exist in Jahia.
options: Model exhibitors as a sdp:exhibitor mainResource folder + a sdp:jcrQuery listing with category facets rendered client-side (the supercar-garage pattern) — needs a browser capture of the live list to get the real exhibitor data
Keep the catalogue page as an editorial page with a link out to the existing exhibitor platform (no entity migration)
Out of scope for this migration
_scopeQuestions.recommendation: Decide at the model gate. Do NOT let a facet component ship: it renders empty controls that list nothing (measured on supercar-garage).
_scopeQuestions.resolution: The catalogue is a THREE-AXIS directory — /Exposant/ (15), /Marque/ (11), /Produit/ (7) = 33 card-reached details, all found by the link census. Recommendation: ONE new archetype `sdp:directoryEntry` (mix:title + sdpmix:media logo + sdpmix:cta website + body richtext + jmix:categorized + standNumber + a `kind` choicelist exposant|marque|produit), loaded into three folders and listed by one sdp:jcrQuery with client-side category chips. Three separate types would duplicate one field shape and fail dup-shapes.sh; reusing sdp:newsArticle would label a printer 'Actualité'.
_scopeQuestions.blockingWhy: Needs ONE new archetype approved (sdp:directoryEntry). Approve, refuse, or scope the catalogue out.
_scopeQuestions.decision: APPROVED: one new archetype sdp:directoryEntry (mainResource, mix:title + media + cta + seo + taxonomy, body richtext, standNumber, and a `kind` choicelist exposant|marque|produit that the view branches on), loaded into 3 folders and listed by a jcrQuery per axis. Three types would duplicate one shape; reusing newsArticle would label a printer 'Actualité'.

_scopeQuestions.question: salon/profil-visiteur has 3 card-reached children (amateur-averti, createur-contenus, professionnel) — 'Le salon selon votre profil'.
_scopeQuestions.recommendation: PAGES, not entities: they are audience landing pages, carry no date, and the rule breaks ties to page. Declared in scope-rules pagesToCrawl.

_articleBodyFinding: MEASURED on 2 article details: an article body is not one rich-text field but a SEQUENCE of bands — content (standfirst + section headings + prose), rich-text, content-block-vertical-image (image+text), video-content-block ('En vidéo'), image. So sdp:newsArticle keeps title/date/summary/hero/categories as PROPERTIES and composes its body from CHILD content nodes (richTextSection / mediaText / video), the same archetype vocabulary as page bands, rendered with RenderChildren. Flattening it into one richtext would make every in-article image and video block non-contributable.
